title: NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos
abstract: arXiv:2611.32431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself. We obtain per-pixel ground-truth labels from real-generated twins: a real clip paired with its re-creation by a keyframe-conditioned video generator. After inserting real keyframes so that the twin camera roughly follows the real one, we measure per pixel, in degrees, how far the twin departs from a rigid scene seen along its own camera path. translated_title: NRG-Twins：生成视频中刚性违例的像素级真值标注
translated_abstract: 视频生成器如今已能生成逼真的场景与物体片段，这使生成视频成为获取3D内容的一个有吸引力的来源。然而，生成视频并不具备3D一致性：静态内容会缓慢变形或滑动，3D重建质量随之下降，且这些错误过于细微，难以通过人工方式标注。为了使生成器具备3D一致性，或构建能够引导其朝此方向改进的奖励与引导机制，我们需要能够指出生成视频在何处、以多大程度违反刚性的数据，而这些数据必须来自生成视频本身。我们从“真实-生成孪生对”中获得逐像素真值标签：即将一个真实视频片段与其由关键帧条件化的视频生成器重新生成的版本配对。在插入真实关键帧使孪生视频的相机运动大致跟随真实相机后，我们以角度为单位逐像素地测量孪生视频沿其自身相机路径所见内容相对于刚性场景的偏离程度。我们发布了非刚性生成孪生数据集，包含871对孪生视频，以及用于构建该数据集的代码。
tldr: 该论文提出NRG-Twins数据集，通过将真实视频片段与关键帧条件化的视频生成器重新生成的“孪生”视频配对，首次提供了生成视频中刚性违例（3D不一致）的像素级、以角度为单位的真值标注。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NRG-Twins, a dataset of 871 real-generated video pairs providing pixel-level ground-truth labels, measured in degrees, for rigidity violations in generated videos, enabling the evaluation and improvement of 3D consistency in video generators.
